_comment: keccak256 of the creation bytecode of the audited v1 validators (default profile, solc 0.8.35, via-IR, bytecode_hash = none). CATValidatorV2 inherits from CATValidator, so any edit to v1 that is not bytecode-neutral fails script/check-v1-bytecode.sh. Regenerate only for a deliberate v1 change or a toolchain bump: ./script/check-v1-bytecode.sh --update
